name: Slimy Eel 61
author: watchakorn-18k
description: Gradient pill red radio button that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: On hover, border becomes 0px, box-shadow becomes 0px 0px 5px -1px #43e inset,0px 0px 5px -1px #43e, transform becomes translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.5). Clicking it toggles it: background-color changes to #f35.
